summary.text: Max Engling is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. He won the nomination at the June 20 convention over incumbent Diego Morales, having worked in Congress for 12 years, most recently for U.S. Sen. Jim Banks.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from IUPUI (2010) and a graduate degree from the U.S. Naval War College (2020).
Spent 12 years on Capitol Hill: a Republican staffer for a U.S. House committee (House Administration, per his bio), an aide to then-House Speaker Kevin McCarthy, and an aide to Sen. Banks.
